The '''Lannik Wilds''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was largely devoid of [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. It was [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] south of [[Lannik Space/Legends|Lannik Space]] and [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EAOC" />
